note: What a server answers a registration with, naming a player in the match and the seat they occupy. It shares its command value with the request it answers, which travels the other way, and it is one fixed size. Straight after a request a server sends one answer for every seat, and every one of them carries that request's build and proof back. A later answer for the registering player's own seat is one a server fills in itself.

fields.name: leading
fields.note: Purpose undetermined. It occupies the same three bytes a request uses, and a server is free to send zeros there.

fields.name: clientId
fields.note: Which seat in the match the named player occupies, counted from zero.

fields.name: version
fields.note: The build the client said it runs, carried back to it. Where the answer follows a request it is the number that request carried, and 42000315 in every one observed. Where it does not, a server states the build itself, and the only payloads that do carry four bytes past the record, so no vector holds one.

fields.name: proof
fields.note: The eight bytes a request fills with its proof, carried back. Where the answer follows a request it repeats what that request carried. Where it does not it is zero: a server states no proof of its own, so a receiving end takes nothing from it.

fields.name: trailing
fields.note: Four bytes closing the record. Zero in everything observed.
